enhanced_name_long: Pre-Engineered Building (PEB) Steel Structure Sheds for Industrial, Warehouse, Factory and Agricultural Use

buyer_intent_queries: insulated PEB shed with rock wool panels
pre-engineered building shed supply and erect
multi-bay PEB shed for manufacturing unit

segment_contamination_dimensions: Portable/temporary shelter buyers (camping, disaster relief, military field use) — sibling MCATs 'Portable Shelters', 'Military Shelters', 'Dome Shelters' serve this segment; names implying portability, temporary deployment, or non-structural use are blocked.
Livestock-specific shed buyers (poultry, cattle) — sibling MCATs 'Poultry Sheds' and 'Cattle Sheds' carve out these sub-segments; names exclusively targeting poultry or cattle housing are blocked.

Specialised application shed buyers (aircraft hangars, telecom shelters, swimming pool covers, auditorium roofing, badminton court roofing) — each has a dedicated sibling MCAT; names exclusively targeting these applications are blocked.

Tin/light-gauge corrugated sheet shed buyers — sibling MCAT 'Tin Shed' carves out this lower-spec segment; the Hindi term 'tin shed' is retained only as a buyer search term but blocked from enhanced name candidates.
Pure fabrication-service buyers (no supply of structure) — sibling MCAT 'PEB Structures Fabrication' covers fabrication-only contracts; names implying fabrication service only are blocked.
